name: Global Intelligence Query
purpose: Answer an analyst question from the held repository, with citations and counted negative results.
triggerDetail: An analyst asks a question in Intelligence.

steps.label: Interpret the question
steps.detail: Resolves entities, timeframe and client scope from the question as asked.

steps.label: Retrieve evidence
steps.detail: Searches the held corpus and logs every search, including those returning nothing.

steps.label: Enrich observables
steps.detail: Runs a reputation lookup where the question names an observable. Each provider verdict is kept separately.

steps.label: Reconcile citations
steps.detail: Drops any citation the retrieval log does not contain, and marks every URL unsafe by default.

steps.label: Compose the answer
steps.detail: Verifies each material statement against returned evidence, then renders counts including zero.

name: Deep-Dive RFI
purpose: Work a client request for information across every collection area, and name the areas nothing covered.
triggerDetail: An analyst files an RFI in Reports.

steps.label: Plan coverage
steps.detail: Decides which specialists the question requires, and which it does not.

steps.label: Dispatch specialists
steps.detail: Runs the selected specialists in parallel, each within its own source scope.

steps.label: Collect across areas
steps.detail: Each specialist returns what it found and what it could not reach.

steps.label: Record omitted coverage
steps.detail: Names any area no source covered, rather than returning a quiet partial answer.

steps.label: Consolidate findings
steps.detail: Deduplicates across specialists and keeps every contributing source on the surviving record.

steps.label: Draft the response
steps.detail: Produces the RFI response as a draft, assigned for review.

steps.label: Await approval
steps.detail: A lead analyst approves. There is no automated release path.

gap: Two of the eight specialists have no agreed collection route: messaging at E1, SOC at M1.
basis: FR-RFI-01 to FR-RFI-04; Praveen Singh, 2 September 2026, 29:21

name: Intelligence Advisory
purpose: Turn held evidence into a seven-section Intelligence Advisory, drafted for a lead analyst to approve.
triggerDetail: An analyst promotes an answer or a PIR hit to a draft.

steps.label: Check for duplication
steps.detail: Looks for an advisory already covering the subject before drafting a second one.

steps.label: Assemble evidence
steps.detail: Gathers the held records the advisory will cite.

steps.label: Draft the sections
steps.detail: Produces the mandatory element set, each section stamped with how it was derived.

steps.label: Resolve MITRE techniques
steps.detail: Resolves every technique id against the held table. An id that does not resolve blocks the draft.

steps.label: Run the quality gate
steps.detail: Blocking checks: technique resolution, citation presence, TLP settled, no invented figure.

steps.label: Assign for review
steps.detail: A lead analyst approves. The agent never publishes and never releases.

name: Vulnerability Advisory
purpose: Produce the ten-section Vulnerability Advisory, carrying each CVSS score with the authority that assigned it.
triggerDetail: A vulnerability collection run raises a CVE matching a client technology stack.

steps.label: Resolve the CVE
steps.detail: Retrieves the advisory text and the affected products and versions.

steps.label: Record CVSS and authority
steps.detail: Each score is stored with its scoring authority. Where authorities disagree, both are kept and the conflict is shown.

steps.label: Check exploitation status
steps.detail: Determines whether a public exploit exists and whether it is exploited in the wild.

steps.label: Match client technology
steps.detail: Tests the affected product against each client's recorded technology stack and current exposure.

steps.label: Draft the sections
steps.detail: Produces the ten-section set, including mitigation and detection guidance.

steps.label: Assign for review
steps.detail: A lead analyst approves. An unresolved CVSS conflict blocks the draft.

name: Threat Actor Investigation
purpose: Build the picture of one actor across every area that holds something on it.
triggerDetail: An analyst opens an actor from an answer, a hit or a report.

steps.label: Resolve the actor
steps.detail: Collapses aliases to one identity, keeping every name it is known by.

steps.label: Gather held activity
steps.detail: Retrieves campaigns, malware, victims and indicators already linked to the actor.

steps.label: Collect vendor reporting
steps.detail: Retrieves each subscribed provider's view, keeping the provider's own confidence.

steps.label: Add observed activity
steps.detail: Adds techniques and tooling observed across the managed estate, tenant scope intact.

steps.label: Map the technique set
steps.detail: Resolves every technique to the held ATT&CK table and renders the heat map as a text table.

steps.label: Assess client relevance
steps.detail: Tests the actor's targeting against client sector, region and technology.

gap: Waiting on the current workflow library content at open item I1 before this leaves draft.

name: Geopolitical Analysis
purpose: Watch geopolitical reporting and raise only the events that carry a cyber consequence.
triggerDetail: Runs on the collection rhythm, and on demand from an analyst.

steps.label: Run the keyword set
steps.detail: Watches the tagged feeds and runs the keyword and topic set CPX provides.

steps.label: Collect reporting
steps.detail: Retrieves the reporting and stores the exact response received.

steps.label: Extract events and entities
steps.detail: Pulls the event, the actors and the locations involved.

steps.label: Assess security relevance
steps.detail: Separates an event with a cyber consequence from general news. Geography alone infers nothing.

steps.label: Correlate threat activity
steps.detail: Links the event to actors and campaigns already held.

gap: CPX tagged five sources geopolitical in the delivered inventory. None are in the set loaded here.
basis: FR-ING-04, FR-COR-02, PIR category Geopolitical Threat and Events

name: IOC Enrichment
purpose: Normalise, deduplicate and enrich the indicator feeds, keeping every contributing source.
triggerDetail: Runs when an indicator feed returns changed content.

steps.label: Fetch indicators
steps.detail: Retrieves the current list. An unchanged feed returns 304 and writes nothing.

steps.label: Normalise types
steps.detail: Maps every indicator to the canonical type vocabulary and defangs it for rendering.

steps.label: Deduplicate across feeds
steps.detail: Collapses the same indicator from several feeds into one record, keeping every contributing source.

steps.label: Validate and score
steps.detail: Refuses an indicator below the confidence threshold. An expiry is set only where the provider states one.

steps.label: Enrich and link
steps.detail: Attaches first seen, last seen and the threat activity already linked to it.

gap: The rule for conflicting reputation verdicts is outstanding at open item N1.
basis: FR-NRM-01 to FR-NRM-04, FR-ENR-01, FR-LUP-01 to FR-LUP-04

name: Client Exposure Assessment
purpose: Answer what one client is exposed to right now, across vulnerability, exposure and attack-surface findings.
triggerDetail: An analyst opens a client and asks for a current exposure position.

steps.label: Load the client profile
steps.detail: Reads sector, region, products and subscribed PIRs. An incomplete profile is stated as incomplete.

steps.label: Collect exposure findings
steps.detail: Retrieves current findings and resolves each to a client asset.

steps.label: Add attack surface
steps.detail: Adds external attack-surface and redacted credential exposure.

steps.label: Correlate with advisories
steps.detail: Links each exposure to any advisory already covering it.

steps.label: Rank by client impact
steps.detail: Orders by the severity the source platform assigned. Nothing is re-scored here.

gap: Neither CTEM nor SpiderSilk has an agreed integration route.

name: Daily Threat Digest
purpose: Assemble the day's reportable findings into one digest, drafted for review.
triggerDetail: Runs once a day, and on demand from a lead analyst.

steps.label: Gather the day's findings
steps.detail: Collects what the collection runs raised in the period.

steps.label: Filter to reportable
steps.detail: Separates a reportable finding from routine news.

steps.label: Rank by client relevance
steps.detail: Orders by how many clients a finding touches and how directly.

steps.label: Draft the digest
steps.detail: Produces the digest, each entry carrying its citation.

steps.label: Assign for review
steps.detail: A lead analyst approves. A quiet day produces a digest that says so.

gap: The confidence gate that decides what enters a digest is outstanding at open item O1.

name: Infographic Production
purpose: Fill the fixed CPX infographic template from an approved artefact.
triggerDetail: Runs when a lead analyst approves an advisory or digest.

steps.label: Read the approved artefact
steps.detail: Reads only an artefact a lead analyst has approved.

steps.label: Extract template fields
steps.detail: Pulls the fields the fixed template expects.

steps.label: Carry figures verbatim
steps.detail: Carries only figures the artefact states. No new metric is computed.

steps.label: Render the TTP table
steps.detail: The heat map is a text table. Generated imagery is out of scope.

steps.label: Hand back for layout
steps.detail: Returns structured content. CPX owns the template design.

gap: Whether CPX supplies the template or we build to a spec is outstanding at open item C7.
